Every refund waits for a named person

The assistant can look up an order and prepare a refund. It cannot issue one. A support lead sees the order, the amount and the reason, and decides.

How it works

A customer asks for a refund and the assistant finds the order. It drafts the refund with the amount taken from the order record, never from the message, and places it in the approval queue. Nothing moves until the lead approves, and a declined refund is reported back to the customer rather than retried.

Each decision is kept with who made it and when, so a question three weeks later has an answer.
